auth.refresh: OAuth2 refresh token lasts 60 days and is single-use; CCG/JWT apps simply request fresh tokens

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Per-customer: Box admin approves/enables the custom app in Admin Console. Public Box Platform App Center listing optional (UNVERIFIED).
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Per Box docs: server-side apps (CCG, JWT) 'must be authorized' by the enterprise admin in Admin Console > Apps > Custom Apps Manager; OAuth 2.0 apps only need enablement 'when your enterprise leaves unpublished apps inactive by default'. Customer creates a service-account-scoped collaboration or grants app access.
access_requirements.time_to_approval: none for custom app; admin approval only

incremental_sync: Events API (/events with stream_position) or webhooks; UNVERIFIED details not fetched
blockers: Enterprise admin must authorize CCG/JWT app
sources: https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/ — 'Client Credentials Grant ... Requires admin authorization'; 'access tokens valid for 60 minutes'; refresh token 60 days
